decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a versatile daypack for hiking. The consideration set includes a mix of large internal frame packs (Mardingtop), tactical packs (G4Free), and technical daypacks (KAILAS, Gelindo, TOMSHOO). I ruled out the Mardingtop 70L because reviews mentioned poor quality and refund issues. The Gelindo 18L is highly rated but might be slightly too small for a full day's gear. The KAILAS 28L caught my eye because multiple reviews praised its comfort and ventilation, with one even calling it an 'Osprey dupe.' This suggests high quality at a lower price point ($69.99) than premium brands. Given the positive feedback on its frame and expandable pockets, it is the most reliable and functional choice for my needs.
